Hi-Dolphin · COFE+Technology07
Under the Hood

Engineered to the gram.

Every subsystem is purpose-built and orchestrated by an on-board smart algorithm — so quality never depends on who's working.

01

6-axis robotic arm

Proprietary arm executes grind, tamp, and pour — even hand-poured latte-art patterns.

02

Dual bean hoppers

Two hoppers run multiple bean varieties, so espresso and single-origin live side by side.

03

Modular ingredients

2–4 milks, 6–8 syrups and 4–7 toppings combine into thousands of made-to-order drinks.

04

High-res 3D foam printing

Prints photo-quality images directly onto milk foam — logos, faces, seasonal art.

05

Smart algorithm

Schedules up to five parallel builds and holds ±0.8g precision on every pour.

06

Remote monitoring

Cloud dashboard tracks stock, sales and health — one operator oversees a whole fleet.
